title: How Number One Governs Every Workspace Event
intro: Follow an event from external AI harnesses into the cryptographic .numberone stream, deterministic replay, Bridge Crew arbitration, and distributed Scrum mirrors.
outro: Every decision, crash, dead-end, and lesson stays replayable across contexts, harnesses, people, and time.

points.title: 24+ AI Harnesses and Human Terminals
points.text: Any MCP client, CLI agent, IDE save, or Git operation enters through open POSIX and JSON-RPC boundaries without vendor lock-in.
points.caption: External harnesses emit tool calls, edits, and Git events.

points.title: Bounded MCP & Watcher Ingress
points.text: NumberOneMcpServer enforces 2 MB pre-allocation buffer caps and L4 privilege rules while WorkspaceFsWatcher debounces live file diffs.
points.caption: Signals cross the L4 ingress boundary into validated handlers.

points.title: L1-L4 Precedence Arbitration
points.text: AuthorityEngine checks affirmative clauses against blocking directives, verified lessons, and unresolved crashes before risky actions proceed.
points.caption: NumberOneAgent submits plans to AuthorityEngine for L1-L4 arbitration.

points.title: Immutable SHA-256 Event Log
points.text: StreamStore scrubs secrets in linear time, chains canonical JSON SHA-256 hashes, stores CAS blobs, and fsyncs to .numberone.
points.caption: Sanitized atomic events commit durably to .numberone/stream/events.jsonl.

scenes.title: 3. Deterministic Replay, Bridge Crew & Scrum Sync

points.title: BMAD Party Mode & KPI Evolution
points.text: Engineering, Security, and Bridge Officers audit telemetry, cross-verify Round 2 challenges, and evolve only when KPI delta > 0.
points.caption: Bridge Crew officers audit workspace posture and record verified KPIs.

points.title: Lossless Distributed Scrum Mirrors
points.text: PersistenceFabric synchronizes Directory boards, GitHub Projects v2, and Jira Agile while keeping full fallback blobs in .numberone.
points.caption: PersistenceFabric mirrors SoR artifacts to Directory, GitHub, and Jira.
